answer: Willow Window Admissions: an agent may join only during a randomly assigned 400ms admission slot, and the slot schedule is derived from a per-identity seed the network commits before traffic begins. Arrivals outside the slot are dropped, so identities must sit idle and hold a connection open across the canyon of dead time between slots. Each identity pays that idle occupancy plus a distinct onyx-marked timing fingerprint that cannot be shared across identities without collisions.
